FSM Studio uses lamejs 1.2.1 by Alex Zhukov to encode MP3 files.
lamejs is a JavaScript port of LAME via jump3r.
LAME project: https://lame.sourceforge.io/
lamejs project: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs

The original lamejs npm package declares LGPL-3.0. The upstream LICENSE
notice (trailing spaces normalized) and complete license texts are distributed alongside the
browser encoder. See individual source files for their original notices.
This library is provided without warranty, including implied warranties
of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose.

License texts:
/fsm/studio/vendor/lamejs-1.2.1/LICENSE
/fsm/studio/vendor/lamejs-1.2.1/LGPL-3.0.txt
/fsm/studio/vendor/lamejs-1.2.1/GPL-3.0.txt

Complete corresponding source (the unmodified official npm archive):
/fsm/studio/vendor/lamejs-1.2.1/lamejs-1.2.1-source.tgz

Download source: https://registry.npmjs.org/lamejs/-/lamejs-1.2.1.tgz
Provenance and checksums: /fsm/studio/vendor/lamejs-1.2.1/provenance.json

The library is loaded as a separate same-origin script:
/fsm/studio/vendor/lamejs-1.2.1/lame.min.js
There are no modifications to lamejs. To use a modified compatible build,
replace this file in your local copy of FSM Studio and serve that copy.
